title: Static review replay recovery
description: Isolated production gateway and real browser controls prove replay refusal without run mutation and a usable same-PR recovery path. A real task workspace and tmux session prove the unacknowledged-start deadline and accepted task progress. No paid reviewer is launched by this recipe.

replay-and-request.intent: Reject runner override and cleaned setup replay over RPC without mutation. Admit live and cleaned monitor replay without replacing the attempt; execution stays disabled in this fixture. Hide unsafe Retry and prefill the same PR request without claiming unknown review readiness.

startup-deadline.intent: Block an unacknowledged terminal after its recorded launch deadline without replacing it; accept a real task mark and preserve child progress, evidence checks and completion.
